# Unsloth Studio Learning Atlas

> A public, bilingual, evidence-aware learning atlas for Unsloth Studio, LoRA, QLoRA, dataset engineering, evaluation, and local deployment.

## Languages

- Turkish: https://usl.aserdargun.com/tr/
- English: https://usl.aserdargun.com/en/

## Core sections

- Roadmap: /en/roadmap/
- Lessons: /en/learn/models/
- Interactive planning labs: /en/labs/
- Evidence record: /en/evidence/
- Data and evaluation: /en/data-evaluation/
- Sanitized learning journey: /en/journey/

## Evidence policy

Every claim is classified as verified, observed, planned, unknown, or simulation. Planning calculators do not execute a GPU. The recorded Qwen3 4B run completed 30/30 steps and saved/reloaded the adapter, but it had no evaluation split and did not prove a quality gain.

Full machine-readable guide: /llms-full.txt
Source: https://github.com/aserdargun/usl-aserdargun-com
